column1: What're you talking about? says the jailer. "I don't have your gun. I sure hope YOU know where it is!"
column2: 「你在說什麼？」獄警說。「我沒有你的槍。我真希望你自己知道它在哪裡！」

column1: You retrieve your kit.
column2: 你取回現場勘查箱。

column1: What are you talking about? I don't have your field kit, Bonds.
column2: 「你在說什麼？我沒有你的現場勘查箱，邦茲。」

column1: You're sure keeping me busy, man. I don't know what else I can tell you.
column2: 「你可真讓我忙個不停，老兄。我不知道還能告訴你什麼。」

column1: You here to get me out of this joint? Saxton asks.
column2: 「你是來把我弄出這鬼地方的嗎？」沙克斯頓問。

column1: Obviously excited, the jailer says..."Bonds! I can't believe what's happened. I can't get over it! We've never had an officer kidnapped before."
column2: 獄警顯然十分激動，說道……「邦茲！我不敢相信竟然發生這種事。我到現在還無法接受！我們從來沒有警官被綁架過。」

column1: Continuing..."Bains took Pate and escaped in Pate's car. I sure hope he's OK. Poor kid...he's just a rookie, you know."
column2: 他繼續說……「班恩斯抓走佩特，開著佩特的車逃了。我真希望他沒事。可憐的孩子……你知道，他只是個菜鳥。」

column1:
Heck, we just put together the file on Bains this morning, and he's gone already.	「天啊，我們今天早上才整理好班恩斯的檔案，他已經逃走了。
What a day THIS has been!....Hey, wait just a minute there, Bonds!"
column2: 「今天真是夠精彩的！……嘿，等一下，邦茲！」

column1: The jailer walks up to you and says, "The bulge under your jacket here...that looks like a gun to me!"
column2: 獄警走到你面前說：「你外套底下這個凸起……在我看來像是一把槍！」

column1: C'mon, Bonds! the jailer demands. "You forgot to put it in the locker outside, didn't you? Stick to the regulations, Sonny!"
column2: 「來吧，邦茲！」獄警命令道。「你忘了把它放進外面的置物櫃，對吧？遵守規定，桑尼！」

column1: The jailer relieves you of your Colt automatic and says...
column2: 獄警收走你的 Colt 自動手槍，說道……

column1: Just contribute five bucks to our coffee fund on your way out, and you can have this back.
column2: 「離開時捐 5 美元給我們的咖啡基金，你就能拿回這把槍。」

column1: While I'm at it, the jailer continues, " give me your field kit to put behind the counter. You're not supposed to bring it in here, you know."
column2: 「既然如此，」獄警繼續說，「把你的現場勘查箱也交給我，放到櫃檯後面。你知道，你不該把它帶進來。」

column1: You hand your field kit to the jailer.
column2: 你把現場勘查箱交給獄警。

column1: Now that THAT little piece of business is out of the way....
column2: 「現在這件小事總算處理完了……」

column1: I hate to be rude, Bonds he says, "but I'm really busy. Unless you have important business, just show yourself out."
column2: 「我不想失禮，邦茲，」他說，「但我真的很忙。除非你有重要事情，否則請自行離開。」

column1: What can I do for you, Bonds? the jailer asks.
column2: 「我能為你做什麼，邦茲？」獄警問。

column1: Here you go, Bonds. The files have to stay here, so give 'em back before you leave.
column2: 「給你，邦茲。檔案必須留在這裡，所以離開前要還回來。」

column1: The jailer hands you the file on Jessie Bains.
column2: 獄警把傑西．班恩斯的檔案交給你。

column1: The jailer hands you the file on Luis Pate.
column2: 獄警把路易斯．佩特的檔案交給你。

column1: Having reviewed the file, you return it.
column2: 看完檔案後，你把它還回去。

column1: The jailer puts the file away.
column2: 獄警把檔案收好。

column1: OK, Sonny says the jailer. "Here's your weapon. Don't forget the five bucks for the coffee fund!"
column2: 「好，桑尼，」獄警說。「這是你的武器。別忘了咖啡基金的 5 美元！」

column1: You donate the $5.00 to the coffee fund.
column2: 你捐出 5 美元給咖啡基金。
